verdict.rationale: Docusaurus ships a well-documented official CLI (create-docusaurus scaffolding, docusaurus start/build/serve, versioning and swizzle commands) confirmed by docs and a probe hit on /docs/cli, all scriptable via npm and usable non-interactively by automation/agents. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation or examples of AI-agent-specific usage/integration, and no independent hands-on confirmation of CLI reliability in automated/agentic pipelines.
